newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges lower after weaker cargo deals.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges lower after weaker cargo deals.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices edged lower after two cargo deals traded at weaker prices late on Thursday and end-users appeared well covered.
May swaps fell $1 to $179.50/$180.50 a tonne with June holding at a $2.50 backwardation at $182/$183. July swaps notionally dropped $1 to $182.50/$183.50.
Cargo prices fell about $3-$5 to $175/$178 cif after two cargoes traded on Thursday at $177 and $175.75.
"I think that is a good indication of where the physical market is right now," one trader said of the cargo trades.
"It's very quiet...The end-users have been covered for the last two months and are covered for the time being."
